system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> hey y'all can you please add tracks from blind guardian's nightfall on middle earth album to the might and myth: power metal playlist."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We’d love to see those tracks added! You can check out more about content requests here: <URL>. Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Doesn't address playlist curation process or how to make suggestions."}
